origins.section: Keep One Objective, and Turn the Other Into a Floor
The Payoff Table Sets the Range of ε
A Sweep Finds at Most One Plan per Floor, So Its Steps Must Fit the Data

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-which-floor: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-which-floor: "Put the one the stakeholder states as a commitment ... in the floor, and the one they want as much of as possible in the objective." The 40 km commitment is the floor (at least), and cost is minimized.
recorded.prompt:q-range: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-range: "Below the range the floor does nothing ... the answer is the NPV plan"; "Above the range no plan can remove that much risk. The solve finds no plan". 30 < 40 gives A, and 80 > 75 gives none.
recorded.prompt:q-grid: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-grid: "A floor sweep finds every Pareto plan only when its steps are finer than the gaps in the data"; "a grid misses it when no floor lands in that interval."

recorded.prompt:q-which-floor:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-floor:a: The same passage says the wanted quantity goes in the objective. That is cost (cheapest), not km.
recorded.prompt:q-which-floor:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-floor:c: "A weighted sum ... cannot take that question as asked. It wants a price" while "The board ... named a floor."
recorded.prompt:q-which-floor:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-floor:d: "The floor is a minimum, not a target"; the floor row is written >= ε, so it means at least, not at most.
recorded.prompt:q-range:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:a: Below the range, "the answer is the NPV plan" (here A), not no plan. Above the range, there is no plan, not plan B.
recorded.prompt:q-range:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:b: Below the range "the floor does nothing", so the answer is the best-value end, A. Above the range there is no plan.
recorded.prompt:q-range:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:c: Below the range the answer is the NPV plan (A). Above the range "the solve finds no plan".
recorded.prompt:q-grid:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:a: "A common summary says 'sweeping ε gives the exact Pareto frontier'. The output above says otherwise."
recorded.prompt:q-grid:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:b: "Each floor returns one plan, so 11 floors find at most 11 of the 65 plans". The frontier is not one plan per floor.
recorded.prompt:q-grid:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:d: "two floors fell between the same pair of neighbours and returned the same plan". A repeat comes from two floors in one gap, not from passing the last plan.
